blocks.text: Reina Filipinas Angelica Lopez has enjoyed the support of four of her fellow delegates at the 2026 Miss Grand International happening in Thailand, saying they would want the Filipino bet to win the title if they will not be crowned. During the closed-door interview held in Bangkok on Sunday, Oct. 4, the panel asked the delegates who they see winning Miss Grand International aside from them. This question has become customary for the pageant in the recent editions.
